categories.main_business_segments: Nanjing Les Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main segments: civil aviation air traffic management, urban road traffic management, and urban governance. The company provides integrated command information system solutions focusing on command and control technology, covering system design, product development, system integration, and service operations. It also extends into low-altitude flight services, intelligent transportation, and data element services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies based on the OODA (Observe-Orient-Decide-Act) combat theory, focusing on data processing, situational awareness, simulation evaluation, and command decision-making. It has developed core technologies such as multi-source heterogeneous data processing, 4D trajectory prediction, conflict prediction, air-ground collaborative control, and low-altitude flight coordination. Production mainly follows a project-based model with in-house design, software development, system integration, and customized product manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies and state-owned enterprises in civil aviation authorities, air traffic control bureaus, airport groups, urban traffic management departments, and urban governance bodies. The company serves domestic markets extensively, with a focus on regions like East China, North China, Central China, South China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest China. It also targets international markets in Asia-Pacific and Africa, including Kenya, Thailand, and Hong Kong.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, covering major regions such as East China, North China, Central China, South China, Northeast, Northwest, and Southwest. It has begun expanding internationally, focusing on Asia-Pacific and African markets, with strategic efforts in countries like Kenya, Thailand, and Hong Kong. The headquarters and main operations are based in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanjing Les Information Technology operates mainly in the midstream to downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on system design, product development, system integration, and service delivery. It provides comprehensive command and control solutions and related hardware, positioning itself as a system-level solution provider rather than a raw material supplier or end-user distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes sustained R&D investment, focusing on innovation in command and control technologies, air traffic management automation, low-altitude flight services, intelligent transportation, and urban governance digital platforms. It pursues technology leadership in domestic air traffic control system localization, low-altitude economy, vehicle-road-cloud integration, and data element services. Collaborations with universities and research institutes support its innovation ecosystem, and it actively participates in national and provincial key research projects.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of integrated information systems, software development, system integration services, and ongoing operation and maintenance services. The company also earns income from product sales, technical services, and government contracts. It follows a project-based revenue recognition model, with income confirmed upon client acceptance and system delivery.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in civil aviation air traffic management systems, breaking international monopolies in core air traffic control technologies. It holds a top-tier position in urban road traffic management and urban governance sectors, with strong market presence in over 300 cities nationwide. It is recognized as a core leader in low-altitude flight services and maintains competitive advantages through proprietary technologies and comprehensive product portfolios.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.61 billion, a slight decrease of 3.94% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 129 million, down 2.31%. The company’s total assets reached about RMB 3.8 billion, with net assets of RMB 1.93 billion. R&D investment increased by 13.21% to RMB 145.6 million, accounting for 9.04% of revenue, reflecting a growth-oriented investment strategy. The company maintains stable cash flow and continues to expand its market footprint.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanjing Les Information Technology emphasizes its unique value in providing highly reliable, secure, and domestically developed command and control systems tailored for civil aviation, urban traffic, and governance. Its products integrate advanced technologies such as AI, big data, and multi-source data fusion to enhance operational efficiency and safety. The company’s comprehensive solutions cover high-altitude, low-altitude, and ground operations, offering end-to-end digital transformation capabilities and supporting national strategic initiatives like low-altitude economy and intelligent transportation.
